description: Edit one file in your workspace by exact text replacement; several places at once. Each edits[].old_text is matched against the original file: exactly (spaces and newlines too), exactly once, not overlapping another. Merge two nearby places into one item. Keep old_text short but unique. If one item does not match, nothing is changed (TextMissing, TextBad). Errors: PathBad, FileMissing.

path.description: the file, relative to your workspace

edits.description: one or more replacements, all matched against the original file, not overlapping

old_text.description: the exact text to replace; must occur once
